title: neomammillaria multihamata
intro: Neomammillaria multihamata, commonly known as "Lobivia multihamata", is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its reported health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neomammillaria multihamata include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, likely attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and glycosides. While research is limited, the plant's bioactive constituents may contribute to its potential health benefits and therapeutic actions.
